entries.title: Pharma distribution analytics non-compete
entries.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates are prohibited from directly or indirectly providing demand forecasting, replenishment, or secondary-sales analytics services to pharmaceutical wholesale distribution or logistics businesses in India during the term and for 12 months post-termination.
entries.quote: In consideration of the Client sharing its depot-level sales, margin and supplier data, the Service Provider undertakes that, during the Term and for a period of twelve (12) months after the expiry or termination of this Agreement (the "Restricted Period"), neither the Service Provider nor any of its Affiliates shall, directly or indirectly, provide any Restricted Services to any Competing Business.

relatedClauses.quote: "Competing Business" means any person or entity, other than the Client and its Affiliates, engaged (wholly or in part) in the wholesale distribution, stockist operations, carrying-and-forwarding or third-party logistics of pharmaceutical products in India.

"Restricted Services" means demand forecasting, inventory or replenishment optimisation, secondary-sales analytics and depot performance analytics, and any substantially similar data analytics services.

entries.title: Employee non-solicitation
entries.summary: AtliQ and Kestrel are prohibited from soliciting each other's employees involved in the Services during the term and for 6 months after termination.
entries.quote: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit employees of the other involved in the Services.

entries.title: Personal data processing and DPDP Act compliance
entries.summary: AtliQ must process personal data solely for the purpose of providing the Services and in compliance with applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
entries.quote: The Service Provider shall process personal data only for the purpose of the Services and in compliance with applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 as and when in force.
